label: kizuna_battle_b_01
text: Osu, new kid![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_02
text: Fancy meeting you here in the home economics\nclassroom! What a coincidence, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_select_01
text: Likewise!

label: kizuna_battle_b_select_02
text: What brings you here?

label: kizuna_battle_b_03
text: So, uh...well, y’see...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_home_01
text: Ms. Dendra tells me she is here for intensive\ntraining in sandwich making.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_04
text: Aww. Well, no use hiding it now...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_home_02
text: Oh dear. I’m terribly sorry. Were you keeping this\na secret?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_05
text: Well, I mean, not really...but it just doesn’t look\nvery cool to openly admit I’m here for “intensive\r\ntraining.” Y’know?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_home_03
text: Understood. I will be more careful in the future.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_06
text: Well, new kid, now that you know what I’m\nup to...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_07
text: I guess you’ll just have to help me out with my\ntraining here![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_08
text: Try this sandwich! It’s the result of my training\nso far.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_system_02
text: Ms. Dendra’s sandwich was soggy and hard to\neat. And, once again, the taste left much to be\r\ndesired...

label: kizuna_battle_b_09
text: That was my meat lover’s prosciutto, bacon, and\nchorizo sandwich! How was it?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_select_03
text: It was, uh, a little meat heavy...

label: kizuna_battle_b_select_04
text: It could have used some more veggies...

label: kizuna_battle_b_10
text: What?! You mean there was a problem with my\nchoice of filling?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_11
text: I guess focusing on muscle-building ingredients\nreally did a number on the flavor, huh...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_home_04
text: Ms. Dendra, I believe a simple addition of butter\nwould have done wonders for your sandwich.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_home_05
text: Butter helps to protect the bread from getting\nsoggy due to the moisture of the ingredients.\r\nIt can also work to enhance the sandwich’s flavor.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_12
text: Butter! That makes sense! Thank you for teaching\nme that tip, Mr. Saguaro![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_13
text: But why didn’t you tell me that while I was\nmaking the sandwich?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_home_06
text:
Ah...well, you see...when I saw you, I had not
realized you had begun your, ahem, food prep.\c
I thought you were simply trying to destroy
my classroom.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_15
text: Well, anyway![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_16
text: New kid! Thanks to you and Mr. Saguaro here,\nI may finally be getting the hang of this![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_17
text: Thanks for your advice![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: kizuna_battle_b_system_01
text: You became even closer with Ms. Dendra!
